## Path accuracy (from the logs, SLAM frame)

Estimated robot position at every stop (after the camera correction) vs the planned polygon. Independent of the start-pose measurement. "pose std" = the filter's own position uncertainty at those stops, i.e. how far the estimated path can be from the true one.

| run | lap | stops | cross-track mean (cm) | cross-track 95% (cm) | cross-track max (cm) | vertex error mean / max (cm) | pose std mean / max (cm) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| square_final | 1 | 28 | 0.8 | 1.6 | 2.3 | 1.7 / 2.4 | 4.6 / 7.1 |
| square_final | 2 | 30 | 1.6 | 3.5 | 4.4 | 3.2 / 5.9 | 3.7 / 4.9 |
| square_final | 3 | 31 | 1.2 | 3.2 | 4.3 | 1.9 / 3.0 | 3.6 / 4.6 |
| octagon_final | 1 | 30 | 0.9 | 2.2 | 2.4 | 1.3 / 3.0 | 4.7 / 7.1 |
| octagon_final | 2 | 32 | 1.0 | 2.3 | 2.6 | 1.4 / 2.7 | 4.2 / 5.6 |
| octagon_final | 3 | 32 | 1.0 | 2.1 | 2.4 | 1.3 / 2.5 | 4.0 / 5.3 |
